name: release-rebalance-landexplore-0.1.0
desc: New mod Rebalance LandExplore 0.1.0: fate coin chance capped at 50% and the shown number made the real chance, then commit and push.
rollback: delete Mods\Rebalance\Restitutor_Rebalance_LandExplore.dll (nothing is stored in the save)
commits: feat(rebalance-landexplore): cap the fate coin at 50% and make the shown chance the real one

New mod Restitutor_Rebalance_LandExplore 0.1.0 (Mods/Rebalance). Land-explore property checks: the fate coin re-roll chance (CalculateProbability inlined in UILandExploreEventView.ListRoleRender, kept as the maximum over the listed navigators in UILandExploreEventModel.Ratio) is hard-clamped to 50 by a ListRoleRender postfix, and a UILandExploreEventCtrl.ShowRatioResult prefix lowers the roll threshold by one so that Random.Next(0,100) <= t matches the number on the button (the original was one percentage point more generous; shown 0% was really 1%). The deterministic check, the navigator the coin uses and the coin cost are unchanged. Requires Restitutor.Core 0.1.0+.
chore: release script for Rebalance LandExplore 0.1.0
